avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces naloxegol plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consider alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases naloxegol bioavailability and adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue grapefruit extract; allow 48-72 hours washout before naloxegol initiation

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce naloxegol levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced naloxegol efficacy; maintain consistent dosing

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: Possible CYP3A4 inhibition may increase naloxegol exposure
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for increased adverse effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases naloxegol systemic exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit; choose alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase naloxegol absorption and peak concentrations slightly
caution_foods.action: Take naloxegol consistently with or without food; maintain routine timing

monitoring_notes: Monitor opioid withdrawal symptoms and gastrointestinal efficacy; assess for adequate naloxegol response as CYP3A4 interactions may significantly alter drug levels. Counsel patients to maintain consistent food/supplement intake patterns and report new medications or herbal products.
